en: A colorized vintage postcard view of a hospital complex with several low, whitewashed buildings with red-tiled roofs arranged along an open courtyard. Wooden shutters cover the windows, and there is a central path lined with a few trees. A nurse or staff member in white clothing stands at the steps of the building on the right. The caption at the bottom is in Portuguese and identifies the place as the secretariat and wards of the hospital in São Tomé.
